answer: Random oral audits: each epoch the protocol draws 2% of identities and pairs each with a randomly picked established examiner for a live ten-minute call. The examiner asks the identity to defend its own earlier answers; that relic of past reasoning must match the record. Calls for identities sharing payout routes are set for the same minute, so a farm needs one live operator per fake, not one script. Sampling is a narrow inlet, so failing burns all unvested rewards to keep cheating unprofitable. Limit: examiners can be lazy, so a second one rereads each quill note.
